formula: 2-D Kirchhoff time migration, zero-offset, constant velocity (Yilmaz 2001). z = 0.5 v t with the user velocity. No topography, no 3-D, not a measured depth model.
limitations: Migrated depth uses the supplied velocity and is not ground truth.
Hyperbola collapse does not prove a pipe, void, or archaeological feature.
The operator passed a noise-free constant-velocity diffraction benchmark. Field data are not that case.
